technical_result: Installed native gas and sparse Newtonian particles are feasible within the measured low-cost limits.
artistic_result: Not accepted. The coarse gas is substantially softer and foggier than the detailed v003 paint; it is not currently an artistic improvement or production replacement.
findings: Real density fields change shape and internal distributions rather than deforming repeated painted lobes.
Sparse actual particle simulation and source-anchored births are present; this is not a shower of large identical graphic symbols.
The coarse cloud has little of the source film's granular brush definition, reads as soft blue-grey fog, and broadens strongly late.
Cold volume emission and blackbody are zero; the brief launch/flash are independent, with no persistent hot core.
The small domain and coarse field do not establish adequate detail, late boundary behavior, shadow quality or4K suitability.
method_limits: Visual audit used representative native-size rendered/exported frames; no real-time full-video playback was performed by the audit.
Comparison holds camera, scenery and children; it does not validate production performance, live masking/contact or a moving camera.
Local preview shading lights and a test collision plane are isolated diagnostic fixtures, not a main production lighting/contact pass.
The physics was cheap; an attempted CPU preview was about7s per frame and was replaced by GPU rendering only after production finished. Final frames use the same GPU renderer throughout.
conclusion: Use this as actual feasibility evidence. Keep v003 as the existing integration candidate; finer gas detail, source shaping and a stronger painterly finish remain quality work before this gas branch could replace it.
